description: A utility mod for skyblock filling in missing features from other mods on 1.21+

mods.name: blade-addons
mods.description: Just some 1.21 mod that ports mods like valley and other requested features

releases.notes:
# Changes
- fixed selected pet highlight in menu not being toggleable
- fixed leaporder not working thanks to hypixel randomly adding color codes
- fixed hide terminal titles hiding titles like rev title
- fixed revive title not being shown after dying on pre4
- possibly improved at location notifier
- fixed warp cooldown reseting when it shouldn't
- fixed invalid regexes not being caught in chat filters
- hopefully made end of run splits not get sent in the middle of class xp

- added a toggle to temporarily disable protectitems 
- added a toggle to remove the "mask" part from the text for the invincibility display
- added hide none stared nametags
- added old tuba sound
- added section completion screen notification and sound
- added maxor tick timer (for vortie spring boots or smth)
- added blood room first 4 mob spawn notifier
- added a quiz progress toggle
- added a toggle each to ignore color codes for chat filters and notifications
- added current Section display
- added changing colors with current section progress
- added prev objective finished in section

- made it so searchbar ignores capitalization
- made searchbar also search the lore of an item
